names.legendary: The Avocado Ripe for Five Minutes

lore.common: Is rock hard for a week, then goes brown the moment you look away.
lore.uncommon: Has a stone so big that there's hardly any avocado left.
lore.rare: Turns itself to mush the instant someone wants to slice it.
lore.epic: Ran out at every café in town on the same Sunday, and the brunch queue went round the block.
lore.legendary: Was perfectly ripe for exactly five minutes, and the whole family ate it in that window.

names.legendary: The Broccoli That Was Finally Eaten

lore.common: Gets pushed to the side of every plate by small hands.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a tiny tree, which some children find very worrying.
lore.rare: Makes the whole kitchen smell when it's boiled too long.
lore.epic: Started a standoff at school dinner that lasted until the bell rang.
lore.legendary: Was finally eaten by the fussiest child in the school, and the dinner ladies cheered.

names.legendary: The Carrot That Saw in the Dark

lore.common: Crunches so loudly that nobody can hear the television.
lore.uncommon: Becomes a snowman's nose every winter.
lore.rare: Is said to help you see in the dark, so children eat them before torch games.
lore.epic: Was pulled up by every rabbit in the allotment on the same night.
lore.legendary: Grew so long that the gardener pulled it up and fell over backwards.

names.legendary: The Cherry That Topped the Cake

lore.common: Has a stone that gets spat across the garden.
lore.uncommon: Hangs in pairs and gets worn as earrings.
lore.rare: Stains every white shirt with dark red juice.
lore.epic: Was picked by the whole family in one afternoon, and every mouth was red by teatime.
lore.legendary: Sat on top of the biggest cake at the summer fair, and was the last thing eaten.

names.legendary: The Coconut That Floated Across the Sea

lore.common: Needs a hammer, a screwdriver and a lot of patience to open.
lore.uncommon: Has a hairy shell that looks like a tiny monkey.
lore.rare: Falls from the palm tree with a plonk that makes everyone jump.
lore.epic: Was cracked open at the beach party, and everyone got a sip of coconut water.
lore.legendary: Floated across an ocean on its own and grew into a palm tree on a new island.

names.legendary: The Cob That Popped a Mountain

lore.common: Gets stuck in your teeth for the rest of the day.
lore.uncommon: Drips butter down your chin when you eat it from the cob.
lore.rare: Pops into popcorn so loudly that the dog hides.
lore.epic: Was grilled at every barbecue on the street, and the whole town smelled buttery.
lore.legendary: Popped enough popcorn in one go to fill the whole cinema.

names.legendary: The Cucumber That Became a Pickle

lore.common: Is so watery that it makes the sandwich soggy.
lore.uncommon: Is sliced and put on tired eyes at every spa.
lore.rare: Turns into a pickle when left in vinegar, and nobody can tell it was a cucumber.
lore.epic: Was sliced onto every pair of eyes at the spa day, and everyone fell asleep.
lore.legendary: Grew so long in the greenhouse that it won the longest cucumber at the show.

names.legendary: The Aubergine That Won Over the Family

lore.common: Gleams so purple in the fruit bowl that people think it's plastic.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up oil like a sponge.
lore.rare: Is so confusing that half the family don't know what it is.
lore.epic: Was cooked in every house on the street on the same night, and the street smelled wonderful.
lore.legendary: Was cooked so well that the whole family asked for it every Friday.

names.legendary: The Grapes That Made the Sweetest Juice

lore.common: Rolls off the stalk and under the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Drops one grape every step you walk.
lore.rare: Gets peeled by fussy eaters who don't like the skin.
lore.epic: Was picked from the whole vineyard in one weekend, and the pickers had purple hands.
lore.legendary: Made a juice so sweet that every child in the village asked for seconds.

names.legendary: The Lemon That Lasted a Year

lore.common: Makes everyone pull a face when they taste it.
lore.uncommon: Has its skin grated into zest for every cake.
lore.rare: Squirts juice straight into your eye when you squeeze it.
lore.epic: Was squeezed onto every pancake on pancake day, and the whole kitchen smelled of lemon.
lore.legendary: Was so big that it lasted the family a whole year of lemonade.

names.legendary: The Melon That Rolled Down the Hill

lore.common: Rolls off the table if anyone bumps it.
lore.uncommon: Spills its seeds everywhere when cut open.
lore.rare: Is sliced into boat shapes that everyone sails at the picnic.
lore.epic: Was sliced for every child at the picnic, and the grass was covered in rind.
lore.legendary: Rolled down the whole hill at the picnic, and everyone chased it to the bottom.

names.legendary: The Onion That Made the Chef Cry

lore.common: Makes everyone who chops it cry.
lore.uncommon: Has so many layers that nobody can count them.
lore.rare: Leaves its smell on your hands for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Was chopped by every cook in the restaurant, and the whole kitchen was in tears.
lore.legendary: Was so strong that it made a tough old chef cry for the first time in forty years.

names.legendary: The Orange That Was Peeled in One Piece

lore.common: Is peeled in one long spiral that breaks just before the end.
lore.uncommon: Leaves white pith stuck under your fingernails.
lore.rare: Is split into segments and shared with everyone.
lore.epic: Was sliced at half-time for both teams, and the field smelled of oranges.
lore.legendary: Was peeled in one piece by a grandad who has been practising for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Palm That Bent but Never Broke

lore.common: Rustles its big leaves in the wind like applause.
lore.uncommon: Drops coconuts at the worst possible moment.
lore.rare: Gives shade to every sunbather on the beach.
lore.epic: Bent so far in the storm that its leaves touched the sand.
lore.legendary: Bent right over in a hurricane and stood straight again the next morning.

names.legendary: The Peach That Dripped Down Every Chin

lore.common: Has fuzzy skin that makes your teeth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Drips juice down your chin on the first bite.
lore.rare: Has a stone stuck so tightly that you have to eat round it.
lore.epic: Was eaten by every child at the summer picnic, and the grass was sticky for a week.
lore.legendary: Was so juicy that it dripped down every chin at the table.

names.legendary: The Pear That Was Perfectly Ripe

lore.common: Is rock hard on Monday and mush by Wednesday.
lore.uncommon: Goes brown inside even though it looks fine outside.
lore.rare: Gives everything its name when things go wrong.
lore.epic: Fell from the pear tree in such numbers that the lawn was carpeted.
lore.legendary: Was found perfectly ripe on the right day, which almost never happens.

names.legendary: The Pepper That Ripened Red

lore.common: Has a core full of seeds that spill everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Changes colour from green to yellow to red as it ripens.
lore.rare: Crunches so loudly that the whole table hears it.
lore.epic: Was sliced into every salad at the barbecue, and the table looked like a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Ripened from green to red on the windowsill in one week.

names.legendary: The Pineapple That Sat on the Throne

lore.common: Has a spiky top that pokes everyone who carries it.
lore.uncommon: Makes your tongue tingle after eating it.
lore.rare: Wears its leaves like a crown, so it thinks it's very important.
lore.epic: Sat in the middle of the party table, and everyone took a photo with it.
lore.legendary: Was so big that it took two people to carry it home from the market.

names.legendary: The Potato That Fed a Village

lore.common: Grows little sprouts from its eyes when left in the cupboard.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the ground covered in mud.
lore.rare: Can be mashed, roasted, chipped or baked, so it's in every dinner.
lore.epic: Was baked in the bonfire for every family at the village party.
lore.legendary: Grew so many potatoes in one plant that the whole village had roasties for a week.

names.legendary: The Pumpkin That Won the Show

lore.common: Gets its stringy insides scooped out all over the kitchen table.
lore.uncommon: Gets carved into a grinning lantern in autumn.
lore.rare: Grows so big that it needs a wheelbarrow to move.
lore.epic: Was carved by every family on the street, and the whole road glowed orange.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that it won the show and was turned into a little cart.

names.legendary: The Strawberry That Made the Jam

lore.common: Has seeds on the outside, which nobody can stop thinking about.
lore.uncommon: Is the star of every summer picnic.
lore.rare: Squashes into jam the moment you put it in your pocket.
lore.epic: Was picked by every family at the farm on the same sunny day, and the fields were bare by lunch.
lore.legendary: Was so perfect that it was the only one used in the champion jam at the summer fair.

names.legendary: The Tomato That Settled the Argument

lore.common: Squirts its seeds on your shirt when you bite it.
lore.uncommon: Is the cousin of every bottle of ketchup.
lore.rare: Starts an argument about whether it's a fruit or a vegetable.
lore.epic: Was thrown in a giant food fight at the festival, and the whole town turned red.
lore.legendary: Grew so many on one plant that the greenhouse had to be extended.

names.legendary: The Oak That Watched the Village Grow

lore.common: Drops its leaves just after you've swept the path.
lore.uncommon: Is climbed by every child in the street.
lore.rare: Is home to so many birds that it sings every morning.
lore.epic: Dropped every leaf in one windy night, and the whole street was ankle-deep.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the middle of the village for five hundred years and watched every house being built.

names.legendary: The Watermelon That Fed the Street

lore.common: Has so many seeds that eating it turns into a spitting game.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the kitchen counter like it's about to roll away, and someone always lunges.
lore.rare: Is sliced into smiles that everyone holds up for photos.
lore.epic: Started a seed-spitting contest at the picnic that went on until sunset.
lore.legendary: Was so big that one slice fed every child on the street.

names.legendary: The Tree That Fed the Whole School

lore.common: Attracts every wasp in the garden to its fallen apples.
lore.uncommon: Needs a ladder to reach its best apples at the top.
lore.rare: Showers the garden with blossom in spring.
lore.epic: Dropped so many apples one autumn that the whole street made crumble.
lore.legendary: Gave enough apples one year for every child in the school to have one a day.

names.legendary: The Apricot That Glowed Like Sunset

lore.common: Has velvety skin that feels like a peach's little cousin.
lore.uncommon: Splits open so neatly that the stone pops out.
lore.rare: Is dried in the sun until it's chewy and sweet.
lore.epic: Was made into jam by the whole family, and every jar on the shelf glowed orange.
lore.legendary: Glowed so orange in the evening light that it looked like a little sunset.

names.legendary: The Spear That Grew Overnight

lore.common: Snaps in half where it gets woody.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who eats it notice something funny later.
lore.rare: Shoots up out of the ground so fast in spring that you can watch it grow.
lore.epic: Was harvested from the whole field in one week of spring.
lore.legendary: Grew a whole spear overnight, and the gardener measured it at breakfast.

names.legendary: The Grove Taller Than the Tower

lore.common: Creaks in the wind like a hundred old doors.
lore.uncommon: Is the favourite hotel of every panda.
lore.rare: Shades a whole path so the walkers stay cool.
lore.epic: Swayed in the wind so loudly that walkers stopped to listen.
lore.legendary: Grew taller than the old tower in one summer.

names.legendary: The Tree That Grew a Giant Bunch

lore.common: Hangs bunches so heavy that the tree leans.
lore.uncommon: Has leaves so big that they work as umbrellas.
lore.rare: Splits its leaves in the wind so they look like feathers.
lore.epic: Grew a bunch so heavy that it took the whole farm to carry it.
lore.legendary: Grew a bunch of a hundred bananas, and the monkeys threw a party.

names.legendary: The Tree That Was a Thousand Years Old

lore.common: Looks like it's been planted upside down with its roots in the air.
lore.uncommon: Stores so much water in its trunk that it swells up.
lore.rare: Gets rubbed by elephants who scratch their backs on it.
lore.epic: Shaded a whole herd of elephants on the hottest day of the year.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same savannah for a thousand years, and every animal knows it.

names.legendary: The Basil That Made the Best Pesto

lore.common: Gets pinched at the top every time anyone walks past the windowsill.
lore.uncommon: Gets blended into pesto that turns everything green.
lore.rare: Wilts dramatically the moment it's left out of the sun.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled on every pizza at the pizza night, and the whole street smelled of it.
lore.legendary: Made a pesto so good that the pasta restaurant asked for the recipe.

names.legendary: The Beetroot That Dyed the Tablecloth

lore.common: Stains your fingers purple for the whole day.
lore.uncommon: Has to be dug out of the ground with a fork.
lore.rare: Turns everything it touches pink, including things it shouldn't.
lore.epic: Was boiled in every kitchen for soup night, and the whole street's tea towels turned pink.
lore.legendary: Dyed a whole white tablecloth pink in one spill, and the family kept it like that.

names.legendary: The Birch That Glowed in the Moonlight

lore.common: Peels its papery bark in strips that blow around the garden.
lore.uncommon: Has white bark with dark stripes like a zebra.
lore.rare: Shakes its catkins and gives everyone hay fever.
lore.epic: Dropped catkins over the whole park in one windy day, and everyone sneezed.
lore.legendary: Glows so white in the moonlight that night walkers use it as a lighthouse.

names.legendary: The Bramble That Ate the Fence

lore.common: Snags your jumper with its thorns as you reach for the best berry.
lore.uncommon: Turns everyone's mouth purple after picking.
lore.rare: Grows across the path overnight, so nobody can get past.
lore.epic: Was picked by every family on the lane, and the whole village made crumble.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole garden fence in one summer and covered it in berries.

names.legendary: The Berry That Made the Biggest Muffin

lore.common: Stains every pancake blue and purple.
lore.uncommon: Rolls off the plate and disappears under the cooker.
lore.rare: Falls into the pancake batter in perfect circles.
lore.epic: Was baked into every muffin at the bake sale, and the whole hall smelled sweet.
lore.legendary: Was baked into a muffin so big that it needed its own plate.

names.legendary: The Bok Choy That Fed the Family

lore.common: Crunches so loudly that everyone at the table can hear.
lore.uncommon: Is tossed into every stir-fry.
lore.rare: Fans out its leaves like a green flower.
lore.epic: Sizzled in every wok at the food market, and the street smelled wonderful.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole family every night for a week, and nobody got bored of it.

names.legendary: The Branch That Became a Treehouse

lore.common: Is picked up by every child on every walk.
lore.uncommon: Is carried home by the dog, who chews it on the doorstep.
lore.rare: Holds a rope swing that every child in the park wants a go on.
lore.epic: Fell in the storm and blocked the whole lane until the village cleared it.
lore.legendary: Became the floor of a treehouse that three generations of children played in.

names.legendary: The Sprout That Was Finally Loved

lore.common: Is left on the side of every plate at the holiday dinner.
lore.uncommon: Has a reputation that makes everyone laugh.
lore.rare: Looks exactly like a tiny cabbage, which nobody can explain.
lore.epic: Rolled off every plate at the holiday dinner and under the table, where the dog refused them too.
lore.legendary: Was roasted so well one year that every child asked for seconds.

names.legendary: The Bush That Hid a Whole Party

lore.common: Hides every child playing hide and seek, with their feet sticking out.
lore.uncommon: Gets trimmed into odd shapes by the gardener.
lore.rare: Catches every ball that goes over the fence.
lore.epic: Hid every child at the birthday party at once, and the grown-ups searched for an hour.
lore.legendary: Hid a whole birthday party so well that the birthday boy walked straight past.

names.legendary: The Root That Fed a Village

lore.common: Has a bark-like skin that takes ages to peel.
lore.uncommon: Is dug from the ground in long roots like giant carrots.
lore.rare: Is ground into flour for bread and cakes.
lore.epic: Was cooked for the whole village feast, and nobody went home hungry.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole village through a long dry season.

names.legendary: The Cedar That Scented the Wardrobe

lore.common: Smells so strongly that the whole garden smells like a pencil.
lore.uncommon: Keeps moths away from the woolly jumpers.
lore.rare: Grows cones so big that they look like little barrels.
lore.epic: Scented a whole forest walk so calmly that every walker felt relaxed.
lore.legendary: Was turned into a wardrobe that still smells of the forest a hundred years later.

names.legendary: The Celery That Crunched the Loudest

lore.common: Leaves strings stuck between your teeth.
lore.uncommon: Snaps with a crunch that makes the cat jump.
lore.rare: Gets dipped into every dip at the party.
lore.epic: Was dipped by every guest at the party, and the dips ran out first.
lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly at the school assembly that the whole hall turned round.

names.legendary: The Chard That Lit Up the Veg Patch

lore.common: Has stalks in so many colours that it looks painted.
lore.uncommon: Tastes a little bitter, so children make faces.
lore.rare: Sprouts a fresh leaf the moment one is picked, as if it's showing off.
lore.epic: Filled the whole veg patch with colour, and the neighbours thought it was a flower bed.
lore.legendary: Grew all winter in the snow, its bright stalks poking out like candles.

names.legendary: The Tree That Bloomed Twice

lore.common: Showers the car underneath with petals every spring.
lore.uncommon: Is raided by every bird for its cherries before anyone else gets them.
lore.rare: Has branches so low that every child climbs it.
lore.epic: Bloomed over the whole park, and the city had a picnic under it.
lore.legendary: Bloomed twice in one year, and the gardener wrote to the newspaper.

names.legendary: The Chili That Made a Chef Cry

lore.common: Makes your tongue feel like it's on fire.
lore.uncommon: Hides its heat in the seeds, which everyone forgets.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who touches it rub their eyes by mistake.
lore.epic: Was eaten at the spicy food challenge, and every contestant drank a jug of milk.
lore.legendary: Was so hot that the toughest chef in town had to sit down.

names.legendary: The Tree That Lit Up the Square

lore.common: Drops its needles all over the carpet.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in baubles that the cat bats off.
lore.rare: Is wrapped in so many lights that it glows from across the street.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole town square for the winter festival.
lore.legendary: Was the tallest decorated tree ever put up in the town square, and the star touched the clouds.

names.legendary: The Palm That Grew on the Beach

lore.common: Leans so far towards the sea that it looks like it's about to fall.
lore.uncommon: Drops coconuts onto anyone resting underneath.
lore.rare: Gives shade to a whole beach of sunbathers.
lore.epic: Swayed in the tropical storm until every coconut had fallen.
lore.legendary: Grew from a floating coconut on a beach with no other trees.

names.legendary: The Berry That Floated to the Top

lore.common: Is so sour that it makes your eyes water.
lore.uncommon: Bounces when dropped, which is how you know it's good.
lore.rare: Floats to the top when the bog is flooded for picking.
lore.epic: Floated across a whole flooded bog, and the farmers scooped them up by the bucket.
lore.legendary: Bounced down a whole flight of stairs without bruising once.

names.legendary: The Currant That Made a Hundred Jars

lore.common: Is so small that you need a hundred for one mouthful.
lore.uncommon: Dangles in little bunches like tiny beads.
lore.rare: Makes a jam so bright that it glows on toast.
lore.epic: Was picked from every bush on the allotment for jam day, and the shed was full of jars.
lore.legendary: Made a hundred jars of jam from a single bush.

names.legendary: The Tree That Stood Like a Candle

lore.common: Grows so tall and thin that it looks like a pencil.
lore.uncommon: Points straight up like a green spire.
lore.rare: Blocks the wind so well that the garden behind it stays calm.
lore.epic: Stood in a row so long that it lined the whole road to the village.
lore.legendary: Stood like a green candle on the hill for five hundred years.

names.legendary: The Date That Was Sweeter Than Honey

lore.common: Is so sticky that it glues your fingers together.
lore.uncommon: Has a long stone that surprises everyone who bites too fast.
lore.rare: Is so sweet that it's used instead of sugar.
lore.epic: Was harvested from every palm in the oasis, and the market smelled of honey.
lore.legendary: Was so sweet that a beekeeper said it beat his honey.

names.legendary: The Old Tree Full of Life

lore.common: Creaks so loudly in the wind that everyone walks faster.
lore.uncommon: Is home to an owl that hoots every night.
lore.rare: Is drilled full of holes by every woodpecker in the wood.
lore.epic: Creaked in the storm so loudly that the whole village stayed indoors.
lore.legendary: Became home to more animals than any living tree in the wood.

names.legendary: The Dill That Flavoured Every Pickle

lore.common: Has leaves so feathery that they float away when chopped.
lore.uncommon: Is the best friend of every pickle jar.
lore.rare: Is sprinkled on every fish supper.
lore.epic: Flavoured every pickle jar on the shelf, and the whole pantry smelled of it.
lore.legendary: Flavoured a pickle so good that the family recipe was passed down for a century.

names.legendary: The Fruit That Looked Like a Dragon Egg

lore.common: Has bright pink scales that look like a dragon's skin.
lore.uncommon: Is white and speckled with black seeds inside, like a cookie.
lore.rare: Grows on a cactus, which surprises everyone.
lore.epic: Stopped every shopper at the market, and the stall sold out in an hour.
lore.legendary: Looked so much like a dragon egg that a child kept it warm for a week.

names.legendary: The Driftwood That Sailed the World

lore.common: Is worn so smooth by the sea that it feels like silk.
lore.uncommon: Gets found on every beach walk and carried home.
lore.rare: Looks like an animal from one side and a dragon from the other.
lore.epic: Was gathered from the whole beach for an art display that filled the gallery.
lore.legendary: Floated across an ocean before washing up on a beach as smooth as glass.

names.legendary: The Fruit That Cleared the Train

lore.common: Smells so strong that the whole shop holds its nose.
lore.uncommon: Has a spiky shell that's dangerous to drop on your foot.
lore.rare: Is banned from buses and hotels because of its smell.
lore.epic: Was opened at the market, and every stall nearby closed for a break.
lore.legendary: Was brought onto a train, and the whole carriage moved to the next one.

names.legendary: The Pod That Popped Across the Table

lore.common: Pops its beans across the table when you squeeze too hard.
lore.uncommon: Is sprinkled with salt and eaten as a snack.
lore.rare: Gets eaten so fast that the bowl empties before anyone else has one.
lore.epic: Was served at every table in the restaurant, and the floor was covered in empty pods.
lore.legendary: Popped a bean so hard that it landed in a cup across the room.

names.legendary: The Fig That Ripened in the Sun

lore.common: Attracts wasps to the garden as it ripens.
lore.uncommon: Has crunchy little seeds that get stuck in your teeth.
lore.rare: Bursts open when it's too ripe, purple and pink inside.
lore.epic: Dropped from the whole fig tree in one hot week, and the garden smelled like jam.
lore.legendary: Ripened on the hottest wall in the garden every summer for a hundred years.

names.legendary: The Fir That Held the Snow

lore.common: Sheds needles into everything nearby.
lore.uncommon: Hangs its cones from the branches like little lanterns.
lore.rare: Holds snow on its branches like a white blanket.
lore.epic: Held so much snow in the forest that the paths underneath stayed dry.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the same snowy forest for three hundred years.

names.legendary: The Log That Kept the Cottage Warm

lore.common: Gives a splinter to everyone who carries it inside.
lore.uncommon: Is always a bit too damp, so it hisses and smokes in the fire.
lore.rare: Wobbles at the top of the stack, ready to roll off at any moment.
lore.epic: Rolled off the woodpile one by one until the whole shed floor was covered.
lore.legendary: Burned so long and steady that it kept a whole cottage warm through one snowy night.

names.legendary: The Ginger That Spiced the Biscuits

lore.common: Is so knobbly that nobody can peel it properly.
lore.uncommon: Zings your tongue so sharply that your eyes water.
lore.rare: Gives every biscuit and cake a warm spicy kick.
lore.epic: Was grated into every gingerbread at the bake sale, and the hall smelled of spice.
lore.legendary: Spiced a batch of gingerbread so good that the whole street came knocking.

names.legendary: The Root That Grew a Ginger Plant

lore.common: Looks like a gnarled little hand reaching out of the vegetable box.
lore.uncommon: Shrivels in the back of the fridge until someone finds it months later.
lore.rare: Sprouts green shoots when left on the windowsill.
lore.epic: Sprouted in the whole vegetable rack at once, and the kitchen became a tiny jungle.
lore.legendary: Was planted after being forgotten in a cupboard, and grew into a ginger plant.

names.legendary: The Gooseberry That Wasn't Sour

lore.common: Is so sour and hairy that everyone makes a face.
lore.uncommon: Grows on a bush so thorny that picking is a battle.
lore.rare: Turns sweet and creamy when mashed into a pudding.
lore.epic: Was mashed into pudding by every family at the summer fair, and the queue went round the tent.
lore.legendary: Was the only sweet gooseberry ever grown, and the gardener kept the bush secret.

names.legendary: The Beanstalk That Reached the Clouds

lore.common: Has a stringy tail that gets stuck in your teeth.
lore.uncommon: Snaps in half with a satisfying crack.
lore.rare: Climbs up its pole so fast that it overtakes the gardener.
lore.epic: Grew so many beans on the allotment that every neighbour got a bag.
lore.legendary: Climbed so high up its pole that children swore it reached the clouds.

names.legendary: The Guava That Scented the Kitchen

lore.common: Looks green outside but is bright pink inside, which surprises everyone.
lore.uncommon: Is full of hard little seeds.
lore.rare: Smells so sweet that the whole kitchen knows it's ripe.
lore.epic: Ripened in every fruit bowl on the street on the same day, and the whole road smelled sweet.
lore.legendary: Was so fragrant that the kitchen smelled of it for a week after it was eaten.

names.legendary: The Hedge That Became a Tunnel

lore.common: Hides nettles at the bottom that sting every leg that brushes past.
lore.uncommon: Keeps every ball that goes into it.
lore.rare: Is home to so many birds that it chirps all day.
lore.epic: Was trimmed so badly in one afternoon that the whole street could see in.
lore.legendary: Grew so thick that children dug a tunnel through it, and the tunnel is still there.

names.legendary: The Herbs That Flavoured Every Meal

lore.common: Gets crowded on the windowsill until the pots fall over.
lore.uncommon: Smells of a different herb every time you brush past.
lore.rare: Flavours every meal in the house without anyone noticing.
lore.epic: Was picked for every dish at the family feast, and the pots were bare by evening.
lore.legendary: Flavoured every meal in the same family kitchen for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Root That Cleared Every Nose

lore.common: Makes your nose tingle the moment it's grated.
lore.uncommon: Has a root so deep that it's impossible to dig up.
lore.rare: Is made into a sauce so strong that it clears every blocked nose.
lore.epic: Was grated for the Sunday roast, and everyone at the table had watery eyes.
lore.legendary: Grew roots so deep that the gardener has been trying to dig them up for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Jalapeno That Fooled Everyone

lore.common: Looks mild, then makes your face sweat.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone reach for milk.
lore.rare: Is sliced onto every pizza, even when nobody asked.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled on every pizza at pizza night, and every guest's face went red.
lore.legendary: Fooled a whole table into thinking it was a green pepper, and nobody has trusted a green pepper since.

names.legendary: The Kale That Became a Crisp

lore.common: Has curly leaves that hold onto every drop of water.
lore.uncommon: Is blended into green smoothies that look like swamp water.
lore.rare: Turns into crunchy crisps in the oven.
lore.epic: Was blended into every smoothie at the gym, and the whole room turned green.
lore.legendary: Was turned into crisps so good that every child in the school asked for more.

names.legendary: The Kiwi That Was Eaten With a Spoon

lore.common: Has fuzzy brown skin like a tiny furry animal.
lore.uncommon: Is cut in half and eaten with a spoon.
lore.rare: Is bright green inside with a ring of black seeds like an eye.
lore.epic: Was scooped by every child at the breakfast table, and the bowls were full of skins.
lore.legendary: Was eaten with a spoon by a whole class at once, and the teacher counted the empty skins.

names.legendary: The Kumquat That Was Eaten Whole

lore.common: Is so tiny that it looks like a baby orange.
lore.uncommon: Is eaten whole, skin and all.
lore.rare: Has a sweet skin and a sour middle, which surprises everyone.
lore.epic: Was picked from the whole tree at the party, and every guest got one.
lore.legendary: Was eaten whole by a grandma who had never tried one, and she grew her own tree.

names.legendary: The Leek That Won the Show

lore.common: Hides grit between its layers that crunches in the soup.
lore.uncommon: Is the most important part of every winter soup.
lore.rare: Grows so big that it needs two hands to carry.
lore.epic: Won every prize at the vegetable show, and the gardener's cabinet ran out of space.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that it was carried through the village on a stretcher.

names.legendary: The Tree That Gave Lemons All Year

lore.common: Has thorns on its branches that catch your sleeves.
lore.uncommon: Has blossom that smells so sweet you forget the lemons are sour.
lore.rare: Hangs lemons so heavy that the branches bend.
lore.epic: Gave so many lemons in one summer that the whole street had lemonade.
lore.legendary: Gave lemons every month of the year, which no lemon tree has ever done.

names.legendary: The Pile That Became a Wildlife Hotel

lore.common: Is home to so many beetles that it crawls when you look closely.
lore.uncommon: Rolls a log off the top every time the wind blows.
lore.rare: Hides a toad underneath that jumps out when you lift a log.
lore.epic: Was home to every beetle, toad and hedgehog in the garden at once.
lore.legendary: Became a wildlife hotel so busy that a nature programme came to film it.

names.legendary: The Lychee That Looked Like a Pearl

lore.common: Has a bumpy pink shell that's tricky to peel.
lore.uncommon: Is white and shiny inside like a pearl.
lore.rare: Has a slippery stone in the middle that shoots out when squeezed.
lore.epic: Was peeled by every guest at the party, and the table was covered in pink shells.
lore.legendary: Looked so much like a pearl that a child kept it in a jewellery box.

names.legendary: The Mango That Dripped to the Elbow

lore.common: Drips juice down your arm all the way to your elbow.
lore.uncommon: Leaves strings in your teeth for the rest of the day.
lore.rare: Gets cut into a hedgehog shape that everyone loves.
lore.epic: Was eaten by every child at the picnic, and they all needed a bath afterwards.
lore.legendary: Was so juicy that it dripped from the chin to the elbow in one bite.

names.legendary: The Maple That Set the Hill Ablaze

lore.common: Drips sticky sap onto every car parked underneath it in spring.
lore.uncommon: Has sap that's boiled into sweet syrup.
lore.rare: Turns so red in autumn that it looks like it's on fire.
lore.epic: Was tapped by the whole village for syrup, and the pancake breakfast lasted until lunch.
lore.legendary: Gave enough syrup for every pancake on pancake day in the whole village.

names.legendary: The Mint That Took Over the Garden

lore.common: Spreads so fast that it takes over every flowerbed.
lore.uncommon: Makes your breath smell fresh for an hour.
lore.rare: Makes a tea so refreshing that everyone asks for another cup.
lore.epic: Took over the whole vegetable patch in one summer, and everything smelled of mint.
lore.legendary: Spread from one pot to cover a whole garden, and the gardener gave up and made tea.

names.legendary: The Nectarine That Was Perfect

lore.common: Looks like a peach that forgot to grow fuzz.
lore.uncommon: Dribbles juice down your chin.
lore.rare: Bruises if you so much as look at it.
lore.epic: Was the star of every summer picnic, and the grass was full of stones.
lore.legendary: Was so perfectly ripe that it was photographed before being eaten.

names.legendary: The Oak That Was a Thousand Years Old

lore.common: Drops acorns on the shed roof all autumn.
lore.uncommon: Is home to every squirrel in the park.
lore.rare: Grows so slowly that it takes a hundred years to look grown up.
lore.epic: Dropped so many acorns in one autumn that the squirrels couldn't bury them all.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the middle of the forest for a thousand years and is home to five hundred kinds of creature.

names.legendary: The Okra That Thickened the Stew

lore.common: Goes slimy when it's cut.
lore.uncommon: Is fuzzy like a little green finger.
lore.rare: Thickens every stew it goes into.
lore.epic: Was cooked into the giant gumbo at the food festival, and the whole street queued.
lore.legendary: Thickened a stew so well that it held a spoon upright.

names.legendary: The Olive That Became Oil

lore.common: Has a pit inside that surprises every tooth.
lore.uncommon: Is so salty that it makes you thirsty.
lore.rare: Dots every pizza with little black circles.
lore.epic: Was pressed with a million others into oil, and the whole village smelled of it.
lore.legendary: Was pressed into oil so good that chefs came from all over to taste it.

names.legendary: The Two-Thousand-Year Olive Tree

lore.common: Has a trunk so twisted that it looks like it's dancing.
lore.uncommon: Has silver leaves that shimmer in the wind.
lore.rare: Grows olives for hundreds of years without stopping.
lore.epic: Gave so many olives in one harvest that every family in the village had a jar.
lore.legendary: Has grown olives in the same grove for two thousand years.

names.legendary: The Tree That Filled a Thousand Glasses

lore.common: Smells so sweet in blossom that the bees go dizzy.
lore.uncommon: Hangs oranges so heavy that the branches touch the ground.
lore.rare: Has fruit and flowers at the same time, which confuses visitors.
lore.epic: Gave so many oranges that every child in the school got juice for a week.
lore.legendary: Filled a thousand glasses of juice from one summer's harvest.

names.legendary: The Papaya Shaped Like a Boat

lore.common: Has a belly full of black seeds that look like caviar.
lore.uncommon: Is bright orange inside like a sunset.
lore.rare: Is cut into boat shapes that everyone sails round the breakfast table.
lore.epic: Was sliced for every guest at the beach breakfast, and the table looked like a sunset.
lore.legendary: Grew so big on one tree that the whole family ate it for a week.

names.legendary: The Parsley That Was Actually Eaten

lore.common: Is put on every plate as a garnish and never eaten.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck in your teeth so everyone can see it.
lore.rare: Hides a caterpillar in its curly leaves that only appears when it reaches the plate.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled on every plate at the restaurant, and the bins were full of it.
lore.legendary: Was the only garnish ever eaten by every diner at the restaurant.

names.legendary: The Parsnip That Tasted Like Honey

lore.common: Looks like a carrot that forgot its colour.
lore.uncommon: Gets sweeter after the frost.
lore.rare: Roasts so well that it caramelises at the edges.
lore.epic: Was roasted for the whole family's winter dinner, and every one was eaten.
lore.legendary: Was so sweet after the frost that it tasted like honey.

names.legendary: The Fruit That Topped Every Pudding

lore.common: Looks wrinkly and old just when it's perfectly ripe.
lore.uncommon: Is full of crunchy seeds floating in sweet jelly.
lore.rare: Gets scooped onto every pudding and turns it tropical.
lore.epic: Was swirled into every pudding at the summer party, and the bowls came back scraped clean.
lore.legendary: Turned a plain yoghurt into the most popular pudding in the school canteen.

names.legendary: The Pod That Held Nine Peas

lore.common: Pops open and sends peas rolling under the table.
lore.uncommon: Has peas that roll off the plate no matter how carefully you eat.
lore.rare: Gets eaten raw in the garden before it ever reaches the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was shelled by every child on the allotment, and half the peas were eaten on the spot.
lore.legendary: Held nine perfect peas in one pod, and the gardener took a photo.

names.legendary: The Persimmon That Lit Up the Bare Tree

lore.common: Dries out your mouth if eaten before it's ripe.
lore.uncommon: Looks like an orange tomato hanging on the tree.
lore.rare: Hangs on the bare tree all winter after the leaves have gone.
lore.epic: Lit up every bare tree on the street in winter like orange lanterns.
lore.legendary: Stayed on the tree until the snow came, and the birds had a feast.

names.legendary: The Pine That Smelled of the Forest

lore.common: Covers the ground in needles that prickle bare feet.
lore.uncommon: Leaves sticky resin on your hands that won't wash off.
lore.rare: Drops cones on anyone walking underneath.
lore.epic: Scented a whole forest so strongly that walkers felt like they were in a cleaning advert.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same mountain for five hundred years.

names.legendary: The Plum That Made the Best Crumble

lore.common: Splits its skin the night before you planned to pick it.
lore.uncommon: Has a stone that surprises every tooth.
lore.rare: Bursts with purple juice that stains everything.
lore.epic: Fell from the plum tree in such numbers that every neighbour made crumble.
lore.legendary: Made a crumble so good that the recipe won the village baking prize.

names.legendary: The Pomelo as Big as a Football

lore.common: Has a peel so thick that it takes ten minutes to get through.
lore.uncommon: Is the biggest citrus fruit, bigger than a grapefruit.
lore.rare: Has a peel that children wear as a hat.
lore.epic: Was peeled at the party, and the peel was big enough to make hats for everyone.
lore.legendary: Grew as big as a football, and the children tried to kick it.

names.legendary: The Prune That Was Once a Plum

lore.common: Is so wrinkly that it looks a hundred years old.
lore.uncommon: Is every grandma's favourite breakfast fruit.
lore.rare: Has a reputation for keeping tummies busy.
lore.epic: Was served at every breakfast in the care home, and the queue for the toilet was long.
lore.legendary: Was once a plum, and still remembers its glory days on the tree.

names.legendary: The Quince That Turned Pink

lore.common: Is so hard that you need a hammer to cut it raw.
lore.uncommon: Has fuzzy yellow skin that smells like perfume.
lore.rare: Turns pink when cooked, which nobody expects.
lore.epic: Was made into jelly by every family on the street, and the jars glowed pink.
lore.legendary: Turned from a hard yellow lump into the most beautiful pink jelly in the village.

names.legendary: The Radish That Grew in a Week

lore.common: Bites back with a peppery kick.
lore.uncommon: Pops up pink and round like a tiny balloon.
lore.rare: Grows so fast that it's ready before you've watered it twice.
lore.epic: Was grown by every child in the school garden, and the canteen had radishes for a month.
lore.legendary: Grew from seed to plate in one week, which the class still talks about.

names.legendary: The Raisin That Was Once a Grape

lore.common: Is so wrinkly that it looks like a grape that's had a long bath.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the bottom of every lunchbox.
lore.rare: Gets sprinkled into every cake and scone.
lore.epic: Was baked into every scone at the village fete, and the tea tent sold out.
lore.legendary: Was once a grape on a sunny vine, and still glows golden in the light.

names.legendary: The Tallest Tree in the World

lore.common: Makes everyone crane their necks to see the top.
lore.uncommon: Has bark so soft that you can punch it without hurting your hand.
lore.rare: Drinks fog from the air through its leaves.
lore.epic: Hushed a whole forest so quietly that walkers whispered.
lore.legendary: Is the tallest tree in the world, taller than a skyscraper.

names.legendary: The Rosemary That Smelled of Sunshine

lore.common: Has leaves like little needles that prickle your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Is the best friend of every roast dinner.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that the kitchen smells of it for days.
lore.epic: Scented every Sunday roast on the street, and the whole road smelled delicious.
lore.legendary: Grew into a bush so big that bees from three villages came to visit.

names.legendary: The Salad That Everyone Finished

lore.common: Spills lettuce over the edge every time it's tossed.
lore.uncommon: Gets drowned in dressing until the lettuce goes soggy.
lore.rare: Has so many crunchy bits that it sounds like a crisp packet.
lore.epic: Was tossed for the whole summer party, and the bowl was empty in minutes.
lore.legendary: Was the only salad ever finished at a family barbecue.

names.legendary: The Shrub That Became a Hedge

lore.common: Hides the garden tap so nobody can find it.
lore.uncommon: Has prickly leaves that scratch your ankles.
lore.rare: Gets trimmed into a perfect ball every spring.
lore.epic: Spread so far in one summer that it blocked the garden path.
lore.legendary: Grew from one small shrub into a hedge that went round the whole garden.

names.legendary: The Spinach That Made Everyone Strong

lore.common: Wilts to a tiny pile the moment it's cooked.
lore.uncommon: Is said to make you strong, so children flex after eating it.
lore.rare: Is packed with iron that gives everyone energy.
lore.epic: Was blended into every smoothie at the sports club, and everyone ran faster.
lore.legendary: Gave a whole football team so much energy that they won the final.

names.legendary: The Onion That Topped Every Noodle

lore.common: Leaves a strong smell on your breath.
lore.uncommon: Has a long green stalk and a little white bulb.
lore.rare: Gets chopped and sprinkled on every bowl of noodles.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled on every bowl at the noodle bar, and the whole street smelled of it.
lore.legendary: Topped a million bowls of noodles at the same noodle bar.

names.legendary: The Sprouts That Grew Overnight

lore.common: Crunches in every sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a jar on the windowsill.
lore.rare: Grows so fast that you can see it change in a day.
lore.epic: Burst out of the jar in one night and filled the kitchen windowsill.
lore.legendary: Sprouted overnight so much that the jar lid popped off.

names.legendary: The Spruce That Became a Violin

lore.common: Drips sticky sap onto every tent pitched beneath it.
lore.uncommon: Holds snow on its branches until it bends.
lore.rare: Has wood that rings when tapped, like a bell.
lore.epic: Dropped a whole winter of snow off its branches at once, and buried the ski hut door.
lore.legendary: Was made into a violin that played in the greatest concert hall.

names.legendary: The Fruit That Turned Into Stars

lore.common: Turns into perfect stars when sliced.
lore.uncommon: Has waxy skin that shines in the light.
lore.rare: Decorates every cocktail and pudding.
lore.epic: Was sliced onto every plate at the party, and the table was covered in stars.
lore.legendary: Was sliced into so many stars that a child made a whole galaxy on the table.

names.legendary: The Root That Made Purple Tea

lore.common: Is purple inside, which surprises everyone who cuts it.
lore.uncommon: Has a hairy brown skin like a coconut.
lore.rare: Turns bubble tea purple.
lore.epic: Was blended into every bubble tea at the café, and the queue went down the street.
lore.legendary: Made a purple tea so popular that the café named itself after it.

names.legendary: The Thyme of a Thousand Soups

lore.common: Has leaves so tiny that it takes ages to pick them off the stalk.
lore.uncommon: Gets stripped off its stalk by running your fingers down it.
lore.rare: Is sprinkled into every soup and stew.
lore.epic: Flavoured every stew at the winter fair, and the whole hall smelled delicious.
lore.legendary: Flavoured a thousand soups in the same family kitchen.

names.legendary: The Tofu That Converted the Family

lore.common: Wobbles like jelly when you pick it up.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up every flavour like a sponge.
lore.rare: Crisps up at the edges when fried.
lore.epic: Was fried at the food festival, and the queue was the longest in the market.
lore.legendary: Was cooked so well that the fussiest eater in the family asked for it every week.

names.legendary: The Hedge Shaped Like an Elephant

lore.common: Loses its shape in one week of rain.
lore.uncommon: Needs a tiny pair of scissors and a very steady gardener to stay in shape.
lore.rare: Is so tidy that every leaf is exactly the same length.
lore.epic: Turned the whole garden into a zoo of hedge animals, and visitors came to see.
lore.legendary: Was trimmed into an elephant so lifelike that a child tried to feed it.

names.legendary: The Stump That Counted a Hundred Years

lore.common: Is sat on by everyone on the walk, even when it's damp.
lore.uncommon: Has rings that everyone counts to see how old it is.
lore.rare: Grows mushrooms on its sides every autumn.
lore.epic: Was used as a table for the whole picnic, and the sandwiches tasted of moss.
lore.legendary: Had a hundred rings, one for every year of the old tree's life.

names.legendary: The Turnip That Needed the Whole Family

lore.common: Was carved into a lantern before pumpkins were popular.
lore.uncommon: Has a purple top and a white bottom.
lore.rare: Is so hard that it takes two people to chop.
lore.epic: Rolled off the farm cart and down the village hill, with the farmer running after it.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that the whole family had to pull it out of the ground together.

names.legendary: The Twig That Became a Wand

lore.common: Snaps in half the moment you step on it.
lore.uncommon: Gets waved like a magic wand by every child.
lore.rare: Gets picked up by birds and woven into nests.
lore.epic: Started a wand duel in the park that every child joined.
lore.legendary: Was used as a wand by a child who now writes famous books about magic.

names.legendary: The Willow That Dipped in the River

lore.common: Drapes its branches so low that you have to duck under them.
lore.uncommon: Dips its leaves into the river like it's having a drink.
lore.rare: Has branches so bendy that children swing on them.
lore.epic: Swayed so gracefully in the wind that the whole river seemed to dance.
lore.legendary: Has dipped its branches in the same river for two hundred years.

names.legendary: The Yam That Fed the Festival

lore.common: Is so knobbly that it's hard to peel.
lore.uncommon: Roasts so sweetly that it tastes like a pudding.
lore.rare: Grows so long underground that digging it up takes all morning.
lore.epic: Was roasted for the whole harvest festival, and nobody went home hungry.
lore.legendary: Was so big that it fed a whole festival from one root.

names.legendary: The Yuzu That Scented the Bath

lore.common: Has a bumpy skin full of fragrant oil.
lore.uncommon: Smells so wonderful that people sniff it like a flower.
lore.rare: Is so sour that a single drop flavours a whole bowl.
lore.epic: Was floated in every bath on the coldest day of winter, and the whole house smelled of citrus.
lore.legendary: Scented a whole bathhouse so wonderfully that visitors came from far away.
